# Test fixtures

`zurich-z14.terrain` is a single quantized-mesh tile from the official
swisstopo terrain service:

```
https://3d.geo.admin.ch/ch.swisstopo.terrain.3d/v1/20250101/14/17161/12503.terrain?v=1.43646.0
```

It is used only to verify the quantized-mesh decoder and mesh builder.
© swisstopo. Do not use it as production scenery data.
